##### **Executive Summary** 

##### **Highlights of international copper market** 

Copper price

in July was trying to move up but ultimately failed. It decreased sharply in August, although it quickly kept stable, it decreased sharply again in September, which showed the lowest level since Q4 2008. As market confidence restored obviously in July, copper price increased, touching the highest since April, however after five consecutive increased, affected by debt crisis in Europe and uncertain European economic outlook, copper price began to reduce sharply and adjusted for three weeks. In case of strong dollar trend and uncertain global economic outlook, not only copper but also global commodity market fell sharply, copper price fell below US$7,000 in late September, which was the lowest level since late July. 

In Q3 2011, average copper price on LME and 3 month average price on LME was US$8,991/t and US$9,012/t respectively, down by 1.75% and 1.72% q-o-q, or up by 24.15% and 24.10% y-o-y, respectively. 

##### **Global refined copper consumption declines in Q3** 

In Q3 2011, output of global main refined copper producing countries increased slightly q-o-q. Although refined copper production in Chile met with low ore grade, transport failure and equipment maintenance, it still higher than Q2. In addition, China was still the major contributor to the growth of refined production, production in Japan recovered from “311” earthquake. Output in Chile and the USA decreased slightly or remained the same as last year, but the increase in China, Peru, Mexico and other countries could compensate for the loss and promote the global output. So refined copper output in Q3 increased q-o-q or y-o-y. 

In respect of consumption, global main refined copper consumption countries mostly remained the same or had small change, but China, as the largest copper consumption country, the demand was still at a high level, only the y-o-y growth rate reduced slightly, China was still the main contributor to the global consumption growth. Due to the consumption off-season, consumption in some countries declined q-o-q slightly. Meanwhile up to now debt in Europe has not pressed on demand, but there were evidences that copper demand will be affected by the economic factors in the near future. It was said that the global largest copper producer, Codelco is offering lower annual physical copper premiums for European buyers for 2012, down by nearly 9% on this year's terms. And it also reflected Codelco was worried about the demand in Europe. 

In Q3 2011, global refined copper output was 4.95Mt, up by 6.2% y-o-y or 2.9% q-o-q; the consumption was 4.9Mt, up by 5.6% y-o-y or 0.8% q-o-q. Refined copper supply on the global market had 50kt surplus in Q3.

##### **Demand for copper concentrate supply a little tight** 

Global copper-in-concentrate seriously affected by strike and bad weather in Q3. Chile government said due to strike, bad weather and low ore grade, copper output in Aug. decreased to 427,420t, down by by 8.7% y-o-y. Copper output of Chile decreased by 4.8% to 3.38Mt, which would further caused supply doubt. 

Otherwise the power grid in the central of Chile suddenly failed on September 24, the power grid provides electricity for 90% population of Chile. Power failure caused some copper mines stopped production. Some mines only maintained one-third of daily level, even they used own generator. Codelco said this accident resulted in a loss of 1,413t copper output. It also said the Ventanse Copper Refinery also affected by power failure, but it did not reveal the loss details. 

In respect of demand, with the expansion of Chinese smelting capacity, Chinese smelting plants kept strong demand, which caused Chinese refined copper output hit a new high again; Japanese demand recovered with the capacity recovery and demand in other countries was stable. 

Global copper-in-concentrate decreased by 1.28% y-o-y to 3.09Mt in Q3, the consumption reached 3.17Mt, as the same as last year, which caused the global copper-in-concentrate market supply gap expanded to 80kt compared with Q2. 

TC/RCs in H2 2011 continued to increase on the basis of H1 2011, Chinese and Japanese smelters both agreed to set the TC/RCs at $90 per tonne/9.0cent per lb. However the TC/RCs on spot market continued to decline and reached the level at $60-80 per tonne/6-8cent per lb, which has a wide gap compared with $90 per tonne/9.0cent per lb in Q2. It was also a reflection of the growth in global copper-in-concentrate demand and the decrease of global copper-in-concentrate output.

##### **Highlights of Chinese copper market** 

Domestic refined copper output and net import both increased greatly in Q3. Affected by off-season copper consumption, refined copper demand in Q3 had a month on month decline, which made copper refined supply shortage in Q2 change into surplus in Q3. Domestic refined copper output was 1383kt in Q3, up by 6.5% against in Q2. Refined copper import was 650kt, up by 33.2% against in Q2. But refined copper output decreased about 60kt. Net import of refined copper reached 643kt, up by 53.1%. Refi

ned copper demand was 1.84Mt, down by 4.2% against in Q2, due to seasonal factors. Domestic refined copper supply surplus was about 186kt in Q3, while supply shortage was about 202kt in Q2. In Q3 2011, domestic copper output had a great year on year increase. Of them, copper-in-concentrate output was 327kt, up by 12.8% y-o-y; copper blister output was 799kt, up by 26.2% y-o-y; refined copper output was1.38Mt, up by 20.9% y-o-y. Growth rate of copper blister output and refined copper output in Q3 reached 7.7% and 6.5% against in Q2 2011, respectively; copper-in-concentrate output in Q3 was almost the same as that in Q2. As domestic newly-added copper capacity was put into production, copper output kept a great growth rate. Copper material supply rose again. Copper prices further decreased after falling below the rising trend line formed in early 2009 since the middle of Aug, due to worries about global economic outlook. Copper price in early October decreased to US$6,635, entering into the most considerable transaction prices range over the past 5 years. It is estimated that copper prices will get support at US$6,400 in future. If Europe debt crisis does not trigger another global financial crisis, it is estimated that copper prices in Q4 will fluctuate between US$6,400-8,800, with the average price of US$7,800 in Q4 and US$8,900 in whole 2011. ##### **Chinese Copper Price** ##### **Copper price hits record high** The copper price on domestic market continued to follow the LME price in Q3, although it approached 73,500yuan/t, touching a high since April 2011, but due to weak LME market, copper price also fell below 60,000yuan/t, 3 month copper price on SHFE even decreased below 52,000yuan/t. On the one hand, because the weak situation in global market, on the other hand, in respect of fundamentals, Q3 was off-season, the orders of the downstream 6 processing enterprises reduces, partial enterprises also became more and more weak. Chinese PMI data was weak in Q3, which brought some pressure on copper price. But recently international copper price resumed slightly, even import was profitable, which would promote copper import in Q3. In Q3 2011, average copper price on SHFE and 3 month average price on SHFE was 67,007yuan/t and 66,369yuan/t respectively, down by 3.21% and 3.32% q-o-q, or up by 17.21% and 16.60% y-o-y, respectively. **Table 3 Average Copper Price on LME and SHFE** ||**LME**（U

The open interests continued to reduce, at that time the investors fled out of the market, in the meanwhile, partial investors had to sell copper to meet the needs of stock market and other market. Due to the decreasing copper price in September, the open interests declined gradually then rebounded slightly. In respect of the open interest statistics, the three major Exchanges all increased by different degrees, because of the decreasing trend in September. The copper open interests of LME increased by 2.6% q-o-q, and the copper open interest of SHFE increased by 16.7% q-o-q, that of COMEX decreased by 3.5% q-o-q, meanwhile, the COMEX fund transferred from long positions since late October 209 to short positions on September 20, although the short 7 positions reduced on September 26, but still not changed to long position state. **Chart 1 Open Interest on World’s Top Three Nonferrous Metals Exchanges** SHFE LME Comex

##### **Copper inventory changes on LME and SHFE** In late Q3, copper inventory on LME increased slightly. Copper inventory on SHFE firstly increased then decreased, because the off-season and the increasing domestic output and import. Although a large Singapore trader said Chinese copper demand was strong, Chinese consumers would continue to buy large amount of copper and the copper backwardation in China bonded warehouse was US$130/t. But in terms of spot market, the price would not rebound up and the supply was not tight. Compared to inventory, the strike and production reduction or out of production was concerned by the market. In addition, the largest copper producer Codelco recently said partial clients were willing to reduce orders, which made the market to worry about the uncertain copper demand outlook. 8 **Chart 2 Inventory and Closing Price of LME 3-month Copper** 600,000 10500

##### **Sulfuric acid prices maintains stable** In Q3, Chinese sulfuric acid prices experienced from stable to down. Upstream sulfur prices were at a high wave stage. Import of sulfur had a y-o-y decline of 27.65%. In respect of downstream products, in lower export tariff on phosphate fertilizer relieved the inventory and capital pressures of phosphate fertilizer enterprises. Sulfuric acid output in Q3 was estimated to rise by 5% or above y-o-y. As supporting factors was disappearing, sulfuric acid prices had a decline trend. The average prices in Q3 was 548yuan/t, down by 6.9% against that in Q2, but up by 73.42% y-o-y. ##### **Chinese Copper Material Supply** ##### **Mining capacity** In 2011, Chinese newly-added copper concentrate production capacity was about 50-70kt/y, mainly including huangshan (Xinjiang Hami) Nickel-Copper Mine, Tuwu (Xinjiang Hami) Mine, Duobaoshan (Heilongjiang) Copper Mine. These projects will be put into production in H2 2011, and make actual production until 2012. Chinese mining expansion projects since this year are as following: **Xinxin Mining Co., Ltd** ’s Huangshan Cu-Ni Mine’s 4,000t/d project started in June, 2010. The mine locates in Hami City, Xinjiang with 84Mt of Cu-Ni ore reserves, including 380kt of nickel content, 220kt of copper content and 32kt of cobalt content. The project with total investment of 1bln yuan will be commissioned by the end of September, 2011. **Jiangxi Copper** ’s Dexing Copper Mine will finish 7,500t/d expansion project this year. The total project with 130kt/d capacity is expected to be finished completely in 2012 on schedule. Overall investment budget will reach 2.7bln yuan. After the whole project being commissioned, its mining capacity will rise to 130kt/d from current 100kt/d. Outputs newly added will include 41kt copper-in-concentrate, 61kg gold and 25t silver. **Chengmenshan Copper Mine** ’s stage 2 of expansion project was kicked off in December, 2009. The stage 2 with investment of 500mln yuan will be constructed for 2 years, and it can process 7000t/d of ores and produce 14.8kt/y of copper in 2012. **Jiangxi Yinshan Mining Co., Ltd** ’s 5,000t/d mining project with total investment of 500mln yuan started in January, 2010. After completion, it is expected to produce 6821t me

tal copper. **Jiangxi Copper** planned to produce 200kt copper –in-concentrate in 2011, up 28kt against that in 2010 

10 

**Zinjin Mining Holdings Group Co., Ltd** ’s Zinjinshan Copper Mine with total investment of 582mln yuan will establish two ore dressing plants which can process 10kt/d and 8,000t/d of ores respectively. And it will also establish a 45kt/d grinding system project. 75% of workshops and foundation engineering will be commissioned in 2011. 

Heilongjiang **Duobaoshan Copper-Molybdenum Mine** is invested by Heilongjiang Duobaoshan Copper Co., Ltd. (Duobaoshan Copper) with a total investment of 3.0bln yuan and planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage is going to be commissioned by the end of 2011. After that it will be capable of processing 25kt ores per day, and producing 117,648t copper concentrates (25% Cu) and 1,401t molybdenum concentrates (45% Mo) per year.  When the second stage being commissioned, 50kt ores can be processed per day, and outputs of copper concentrates (25% Cu) and molybdenum concentrates (45%) will reach 233,316t and 3,014 t respectively. 

**Tuwu Mine** , in Hami, Xinjiang Autonomous Region, was started on Feb. 25, 2010. The project is planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage is open pit project and is going to be commissioned in 2011. After that it will be capable of processing 5kt ores per day in stage 1, and the processing capacity will be expanded to 10kt in stage 2. The project is invested by Xinjiang Huajin Copper Co., Ltd. under Central Asia Huajin Copper Co., Ltd. 

**Xinjiang Hudehe Copper mine** 's 6Mtpy copper mining project kicked off on Sep. 16, which is is a large-scale porphyry copper deposit in Toli County, Tacheng Prefecture, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, with proven reserve was 362.5kt metal copper, and 1Mt prospective reserve. The preliminary scheme is to complete 6Mtpy mining project, with total investment budget of 1.47 billion yuan. After being put into production, the project is estimated to produce 15kt copper-in-concentrate. 

**Tongling Tongshan Mining Company** ’s deep mining project started in early September. The project’s designed ores processing capacity is 2kt/d and 660kt/y. The project is designed to produce 5kt copper per year. It is estimated to be completed by the end of 2013. 

#### **Import of raw materials** 

#### **Copper blister:** 

Import of copper blister (including copper anode) in Q3 kept stable. Copper blister import kept at above 30kt in Sep and 43kt in Jul, only less than that in Jan 2011. According to data released by China Customs, during Jan-Aug, cumulative copper blister import was 273kt, up by 14.9% y-o-y. 

The main original import countries in Jan-Aug is Zambia, Chile and Democratic republic of Congo, the import from above 3countries was 103.8kt, 83.0kt and 57.4kt, up by 9.1%, 38.9% and 55.1% y-o-y, respectively, accounting for 38.0%, 30.4% and 21.0% of total.

Of which investment in power source and power grid was 209.8 bln yuan and 184.1 bln yuan, up by 6.7% and 8.7 % y-o-y respectively. This showed that growth rate of investment in power source declined and investment in power grid was still speeding up. Benefited from investment growth in electric power, output of related products as power generating equipments, transformers, power cables and etc. kept a good growth, which became major forces to support domestic copper consumption. Although growth rate of household refrigerator output and household ice-box output declined, air conditioners output, as the large copper using products, kept a high growth rate in air conditioning and refrigeration industry. During Jan-Aug, air conditioner output reached 108.7 million sets, up by 40.7% y-o-y. The high growth rate of air conditioner output is estimated to make copper consumption rise in air conditioning and refrigeration industry. During Jan-Aug, autos output

increased by 4.7% y-o-y, far lower than last year. Investment in railway infrastructure had a great increase in August after the great year on year decline in July. Investment in railway infrastructure was 316.5 billion yuan during Jan-Aug 2011, down by 44.1% y-o-y. Investment in railway infrastructure was 356.1 billion yuan during Jan-Aug 2010, up by 21.1% y-o-y. Weak consumption in transportation industry had a negative impact on copper consumption. According to statistics from State Statistics Bureau, during Jan-Aug, investment in domestic real estate had a year-on-year increase of 33.2%, 3.5 percentage points lower than last year. New commenced area increased by 25.8% y-o-y; completion area and sales area rose by 14.7% and 13.6% respectively, 4 and 6.9 percentage points higher than last year. Nevertheless, lower growth rate of investment in real estate industry and new commenced area might made negative effects on copper consumption.
